articles.title: Digital Asset lands $355M as a16z doubles down on Wall Street blockchain rails
articles.snippet: Digital Asset raised $355M in an a16z‑led round at a $2B valuation, extending a Wall Street‑backed funding run as banks ramp up pilots on its Canton Network blockchain.

articles.title: UK crypto advocates launch campaign against banks blocking exchange transfers
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto UK says banks are restricting access to regulated exchanges even as policymakers seek to position the country as a hub for digital asset innovation.

articles.title: Anchorage backs Treasury’s GENIUS AML rules, seeks secondary-market sanctions clarity
articles.snippet: A public comment letter argues that regulated stablecoin issuers need clearer compliance standards to avoid sanctions risks tied to secondary-market activity.

articles.title: Tenev says Robinhood won underwriter approval as crypto markets front-run mega IPOs
articles.snippet: Robinhood’s new IPO underwriter role comes as SpaceX prepares a record-breaking public offering, with retail brokers and crypto-native derivatives platforms racing to shape price discovery and access.

articles.title: Fold Shares Jump 162% After Bitcoin Fintech Sells $45 Million in BTC, Wipes Out Debt
articles.snippet: Publicly traded Fold sold Bitcoin holdings to restructure its balance sheet, fueling a stock surge on Wednesday morning.
